property_summary: For any call to fallback with msg.value == 10 ether and block.timestamp strictly greater than the previous call, the reference contract only drains its balance to the caller when block.number % 15 == 0; the mutant inverts that condition and so for some block numbers the mutant will transfer when the reference does not (changing address(c).balance), which this test detects by fuzzing the block number and timestamp.
change_summary: Invert the divisibility check so transfer happens when block.number % 15 != 0 instead of when it equals 0, changing when callers receive the balance.
